about.title: About FunCuby
about.description: This project is an unofficial open-source web tool for CubyFun easyplay 1s, with Bluetooth connectivity, MIDI playback and practice.
about.star: If this project helped you, please give me a Star ⭐!

connection.choosing: Waiting for permission or device selection

device.rangeWarning: This pitch is outside the current layout. Check the first-key calibration.

calibration.title: First-key calibration
calibration.hint: Press the physical first key to align the layout. Both keyboard views then show the pitches the device actually sends. Only the page display changes.
calibration.waiting: Press the first key on the physical keyboard; click again to cancel.

rxFormat.label: Receive format
rxFormat.hint: Auto prefers 80 80 packets. If timestamps and running status are ambiguous, switch to the timestamped format. Connecting only subscribes to notifications and sends no initialisation commands.

send.pitches: Pitches (decimal, separated by spaces or commas)

raw.label: One HEX packet or sleep milliseconds per line
raw.hintBefore: One packet per line, never merged and without added headers, up to 512 bytes each. A line
raw.hintAfter: waits 101 ms after the previous packet is written before running the next line; decimals allowed, 0–60000 ms. Blank lines are ignored and every line is validated before sending. “Cancel pending” aborts the wait and anything after it.

send.written: Written; this is not an acknowledgement from the device.

rawDone.one: The line-by-line send finished with {count} packet; a browser write does not mean the device executed it.
rawDone.other: The line-by-line send finished with {count} packets; a browser write does not mean the device executed them.

send.cancelled: Sends that had not started were cancelled; the write in progress will finish normally.

tempo.noDurations: Original {bpm} BPM · no note lengths to calculate from

play.noNotes: This MIDI file has no playable notes.

skippedReleases.one: {count} short-gap release skipped in this song
skippedReleases.other: {count} short-gap releases skipped in this song

hint.lengthen: Short notes are first stretched to the shortest note length, then overlapping releases of the same pitch are merged
hint.gap: A release is skipped when the next press on the same channel and pitch follows within the threshold
hint.zero: Set 0 to turn either step off
hint.program: Each channel's program is set once when playback starts
hint.tempo: Playback works best when the shortest note is about 500 ms; use the target shortest note to calculate the BPM

mode.label: Mode
mode.follow: Follow · wait for the right keys

key.unmarked: No key signature in the MIDI file · using 1=C
key.uploadFirst: Upload a MIDI file to read its key
key.chooseTracks: Choose practice tracks to show the key

score.title: Numbered score and loop range
score.hint: Click a beat on any track to set A / B, or drag across beats to select a range. All tracks share the range, and B sits after the last selected beat. The bar fields select whole bars. Beats show onsets and held notes; the approach rings set the actual rhythm.
score.sheet: Numbered score of the practice tracks

loop.label: Loop
loop.rangeEmpty: Choose practice tracks to show the range

feedback.followFirstKey: Follow the rings on the first key

mapping.title: First-key pitch
mapping.hint: Press the physical first key to align the layout; labels show the pitches the device sends. Shared with the Device page.

latency.title: Input latency calibration
latency.hint: Follow 8 approach rings on the first key and press and release as each ring closes. At least 5 hits are needed; the median timing error is used.
latency.offset: Fixed offset (ms, positive compensates late input)
latency.current: Fixed offset {offset}, shared by practice and the metronome

results.formula: osu!lazer click-only scoring with no mods or bonuses, out of 1,000,000. Accuracy weights 300 / 100 / 50 / 0
results.followUntimed: Follow mode is not scored on timing and does not count misses.
results.noHits: No notes were hit this time.
results.early: Hits were {error} ms early on average (calibration applied).
results.late: Hits were {error} ms late on average (calibration applied).
results.stoppedMisses: Ended early; unfinished notes count as misses.
